recentItems.title: Trump's foreign beef deal draws skepticism from farmers and cattle ranchers nationwide
recentItems.description: Jason Leavitt understands what Pres. Trump is trying to do with the foreign beef deal, importing 300,000 metric tons of ground beef and selling it 25% below market value, but Leavitt believes that move is just a band aid on a bigger problem.

recentItems.title: Supreme Court lets White House continue construction on Trump's $400 million ballroom
recentItems.description: A divided Supreme Court on Monday allowed the White House to continue construction on a $400 million ballroom project as lawsuits play out. The decision replaces a temporary order from Chief Justice John Roberts previously issued hours before a lower-court decision halting the work would have gone into effect.

recentItems.title: ICE buys 6,650 electric shock gloves; Democrats demand the deal be canceled
recentItems.description: Democratic lawmakers from Capitol Hill to California are pushing back on a plan at ICE to equip agents with electric shock gloves. ICE approved a deal last week to buy 6,650 electric shock gloves that deliver a low voltage shock upon contact with skin.

recentItems.title: Trump threatens further Iran strikes as missiles intercepted overnight
recentItems.description: The U.S. military conducted strikes against Iran for the first time in weeks, and Iran retaliated, as the war between the countries surpassed six months.

recentItems.title: First Warning Forecast: Several days with a heat index to 100+
recentItems.description: Hot & humid with highs in the 90s and a heat index to 100+ through midweek. A cold front will bring in more rain and lower temperatures to end the week.

recentItems.title: Norfolk State has Old Dominion's full attention entering Saturday's showdown
recentItems.description: Old Dominion and Norfolk State will square off for the first time since 2019 this Saturday. It will mark the Monarchs' season opener, while the Spartans are coming off a lopsided season-opening victory.
